messages:
sourcing-alex: Heads up — PO #RWI-4821 was flagged by procurement. Vendor says partial replace available but they want RMA for 8/24 units first. can we accept split delivery into FRA and AMS?
zenith-logistics: We can split, but two notes: 1) FRA shipment needs HS code clar for customs (vendor requests 84733000?) 2) partial replace will be air vs sea (air ETA ~5 business days after RMA clear).
ops-micah: @zenith-logistics confirm HS code — our customs broker previously used 84733020. mismatch will trigger duties hold.
zenith-logistics: Understood. We'll ask vendor to reissue paperwork. They propose this AWB for the air partial replace: `AWB: 123-45678901` and a consolidated sea BL for the remainder.
logistics-eric: Can vendor provide pallet photos + serial manifest before pick? we need to reconcile to avoid depot rejects. small sample is fine.
zenith-logistics: Yes — vendor will upload photos and a CSV manifest with serials. sample row format: `serial,model,condition`
ops-micah: If FRA clears faster we can route the partial air there and hold the sea for AMS. But we need to decide cost split for courier premium.
finance-tara: For courier premium, procurement suggests vendor covers expedited for DOA units; otherwise split 50/50 for optional expedite. Need a written note in the PO amendment.
sourcing-alex: @finance-tara ok will ask vendor to accept PO amendment for DOA expedite. @zenith-logistics please confirm vendor ack in writing.
zenith-logistics: Vendor ack'd in thread: they accept PO amendment for DOA expedite and will absorb insurance for air leg. They asked for a 2% reprice on the sea leg because of separate routing overhead.
ops-micah: 2% seems reasonable given handling. Can we reduce customs risk by matching HS code to earlier shipments? if vendor agrees we'll accept.
zenith-logistics: Vendor agreed to use HS `84733020` to match prior entry. They also requested a single RMA reference on the airwaybill: `RMA-RWI-4821` and to have depot pre-alerted.
logistics-eric: Great. Once we have manifest & AWB I'll create the depot intake ticket and prebook photos QC slot.
ops-bot: Reminder — create ticket RWY-1902 for depot intake after manifest upload.
sourcing-alex: Requesting vendor upload the CSV and photos by EOD PST. if not, we push all to sea and delay. any objections?
finance-tara: No objections. please cc finance on the PO amendment email so we can sign off.
zenith-logistics: Uploaded manifest + photos now: link https://files.zenith.example/poRWI-4821/manifest.csv (sample attached). AWB `123-45678901` scheduled pickup tomorrow 0800 local.
ops-micah: Received. I'll kick off depot pre-alert and tag ops-oncall. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
